description: Norfolk Southern Corporation is an Atlanta, Georgia-based company that owns a major freight railroad, Norfolk Southern Railway Company, and it was incorporated on July 23, 1980 under the laws of the Commonwealth of Virginia, with its common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol NSC. It is primarily engaged in the rail transportation of raw materials, intermediate products and finished goods primarily in the Southeast, East and Midwest and, via interchange with rail carriers, to and from the rest of the United States, and it also transports overseas freight through several Atlantic and Gulf Coast ports, offering the most extensive intermodal network in the eastern half of the U.S.
